DeterminationBasis: T07-002 establishes detection and classification of material governed-state change. T07-007 establishes identification of affected governing predicates where that relationship can be established. Together these existing tests cover the capability to detect material change relevant to mandatory governance predicates without requiring a new test definition.

T07-006 explicitly requires a detected material change to be represented separately from the predecessor state while the predecessor state remains preserved as the predecessor. This directly covers predecessor preservation and does not require a new test definition.
